message_1_subject: Stratagem Labs renewal + capacity addendum — invoice routing and PO details
message_1_body:
Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion, we have the renewal terms ready and the team approved a 35% capacity uplift for the next 12 months. To get the invoice processed on your side without delay we need to confirm a couple of billing items: 

1) Which entity should we invoice (legal payor) for the commitment?
2) Will you be issuing a PO? If so, can you confirm the PO number and the exact remit-to email (AP contact) so we can attach it to the invoice?
3) Do you require a W-9 (US) or a VAT certificate / EU tax form for Stratagem?

Connor is on copy to generate the addendum and Marcus will issue the W-9 from finance. If you can send the PO or confirm the billing contact today we can align invoice dates to the renewal effective 2027-07-01.

Next steps I propose: once we have the PO and remit info, we’ll send a consolidated renewal + capacity addendum (two-page doc) and the final invoice. I’ll also include a DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0194

Attachment: renewal_capacity_addendum_draft.pdf (draft addendum — client visible fields highlighted)
message_2_subject: Re: Stratagem Labs renewal + capacity addendum — invoice routing and PO details
message_2_body:
Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the follow-up. Quick answers: 

1) Invoice payor: Stratagem Labs, Inc. (US entity) — remit to the AP team (finance@stratagem.ai).
2) We will issue a PO and route it to you — PO #56789; I’ve asked AP to send a formal PDF. You can attach it to the invoice.
3) We need a current W-9. For our EU subsidiaries we’ll request VAT docs separately if/when they consume capacity, but for this committed seat the W-9 is sufficient.

I’m attaching the PO as a placeholder; AP will also upload to our procurement portal. Please confirm the invoice date you plan to use and whether Redwood can split invoices across monthly consumption vs. committed capacity.

Thanks —
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Stratagem Labs
elena.ruiz@stratagem.ai

Attachment: Stratagem_PO_56789.pdf
message_3_subject: RE: Invoice routing and W-9 — Stratagem Labs renewal
message_3_body:
Hi Elena —

Thanks for the PO. We’ll mark the invoice to Stratagem Labs, Inc. and attach the PO reference #56789. Per your question on invoice cadence: Redwood can issue a one-time invoice for the committed annual amount (effective 2027-07-01) and then monthly usage invoices for overage/consumption, or we can split into monthly committed invoices — whichever matches your AP workflow. 

If Stratagem prefers one annual invoice we can issue it net30 upon the effective date; for monthly committed invoices we can set net30 terms and include the PO on each invoice. Please confirm your preference. 

Attached is our current W-9 for your records. I can also upload the signed addendum once Soojin confirms the final signatory.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf
message_4_subject: Final: Renewal addendum & invoice cadence — next steps
message_4_body:
Elena / AP team —

• Redwood will send the finalized renewal + capacity addendum for signature via DocuSign by end of day tomorrow (I’ll copy the HubSpot deal).
• Marcus has attached the W-9; Connor will attach the signed addendum to the invoice package.

Next actions for Stratagem: please confirm you’re good with the annual committed invoice + monthly overage flow; once we have that confirmation Connor will kick off the DocuSign envelope and finance will queue the invoice to align with 2027-07-01 effective date.

Thanks again — excited to ramp with you.

Best,
Soojin
